root_idea.summary: The root expresses spreading, extending, and forming an extended upper surface.
root_idea.development: From the basic act of spreading or extending, the root develops terms for a surface or roof, lying spread out, flat structures, places and implements used for spreading or supporting things, and plants that spread along the ground.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form سَطَحَ; the Quran occurrence is its passive feminine form سُطِحَتْ.

senses.definition: To be spread out into an extended, level surface.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic passive construction, said of the earth: it is spread out or laid level.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To spread or lay something out, or to make its surface flat and even; for example, to spread dates for drying, spread crumbled bread in a bowl, or make a roof or grave-top flat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive Classical uses covering material spread out for drying or serving and surfaces deliberately made level.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To throw someone down so that he lies extended on his back or side, or to make a she-camel lie on its breast.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use describing the resulting position of a person or animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To send a lamb or kid along with its mother.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical use referring to a young sheep or goat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become spread out, extended, or expanded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Intransitive use describing the subject as becoming extended or spread.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become extended and lie helplessly on the back or spread upon the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said especially of a person immobilized by prolonged illness or crippling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Spread or extended; specifically, lying spread out on the back or ground, including one helpless from prolonged illness or crippling, one born too weak to stand, or one slain and lying on the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of a person or other being in an extended, helpless, or slain state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The uppermost part or surface of a house, chamber, or anything; especially a flat roof.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may refer generally to an upper surface or specifically to a flat roof.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In geometry, a plane: a surface extending in length and breadth and bounded by a line or lines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Technical geometrical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A leathern water vessel or waterskin made from two skins placed opposite each other.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A small or large water container, with the مزادة properly so called described as larger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A low, spreading plant that grows on level or soft ground and spreads along the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to a particular plant or, more generally, to a plant that spreads without growing tall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An even or level place on which dates are spread and dried; a date-drying floor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The place noun may denote the area where the dates are laid out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the plural مَسَاطِحُ, land bare or destitute of pasture, likened to flat-topped houses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional descriptive expression for barren land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rolling pin or similar implement used to spread bread or dough.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An instrument named for its spreading function.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pole or transverse wooden support used in a tent framework or for supporting grapevines.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term covers the tent pole and the crosspiece laid across vine supports.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A smooth, broad slab of rock or hard stone bordered so that water collects in it, including a slab at a well from which camels are watered.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A natural or prepared water-collecting basin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mat woven from palm leaves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A woven article made from خوص or طُفْى leaves of the doum palm.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A large roasting pan in which wheat is roasted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A cooking vessel, specifically a broad pan for roasting grain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A travelling mug or drinking vessel with one flat side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A portable vessel resembling a مطهرة and not four-sided.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Flat or planar; specifically, a roof made flat and even.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Opposed to a rounded or spherical form when used in the general adjectival sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a nose that spreads very widely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical adjectival use.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers spreading, extending, and making surfaces level.
Throwing down or making an animal lie.
Sending a young animal with its mother.
Helpless, weak, or slain persons lying spread out.
Illustrative flat-roofed-house example; adds no independent lexical meaning.

cautions: The single Quran token is the passive feminine perfect سُطِحَتْ; the public headword is normalized to the Form I perfect citation form سَطَحَ.
The Quranic sense is limited to the attested earth-spreading or leveling construction; the additional branches are broader Classical Arabic usages.
